This is going to be one fun day!! . There will food, drinks, music and lots of snow. We will be jamming most the day. It will be a $10.00 dollar minimum donation to do the event. There will be a raffle, lots of prizes, winners get sponsored by 2 different companies. and it is for a good cause. Once everyone is felling good we will start the Jam session, we go for a couple hours so there is no rush on getting your tricks. Then  everyone can keep shredding on. This rail jam is for fun so there will be no judges, you will judge amongst your selves. You decide who kept the stoke all day and killed it. We will use the crowd for tie beakers.  Everyone who does the event gets a free raffle ticket, and a free day pass to the Wasatch Project/CIK foam pit.. See everyone there and remember its not just a rail jam its a fundraiser!

Theres more! 
The Jam is going on at the same time and in conjunction with the Ogden Vally Winter Sports Foundation Ski Swap. Sell your old gear, and get some new gear at the same time as you shred the new Wasatch project jam feature. All the info about  the swap can be found on the web at http://snowbasinskiswap.com

Think Endlesswinter and see you there.

data.description:
America, the Greatest Country God ever gave Man, was built on three bedrock principles: Freedom. Liberty.  And Fear - that someone might take our Freedom and Liberty. But now, there are dark, optimistic forces trying to take away our Fear -- forces with salt and pepper hair and way more Emmys than they need. They want to replace our Fear with reason. But never forget - "Reason" is just one letter away from "Treason."  

Coincidence? Reasonable people would say it is, but America can't afford to take that chance. So join The Rev. Sir Dr. Stephen T. Colbert, D.F.A. on October 30th for the "March to Keep Fear Alive" in Washington DC. Pack an overnight bag with five extra sets of underwear -- you're going to need them.   Because, to Restore Truthiness we must always... Shh!!! What's that sound?!  I think there's someone behind you! Run!

Find out what your fellow citizens are doing to help Keep Fear Alive in the Colbert Nation forums. http://bit.ly/cMFMy0

Keep checking back for updates and rally information.
http://www.keepfearalive.com/
http://twitter.com/stephenathome

Frequently Asked Questions: http://bit.ly/bM6Ic0
Message Boards: http://bit.ly/cMFMy0
Official March to Keep Fear Alive poster: http://bit.ly/aEoITS (jpg)
Shop: http://bit.ly/9LJQmM

All net proceeds go to benefit the Yellow Ribbon Fund.

data.description:
Study Footwear and UCLA's Cultural Affairs Commission's Art Series present "A NIGHT OF CREATIVITY FUELED BY SHOE DESIGN" to kickoff a month long exhibition in Kerkhoff Art Gallery and to launch UCLA's first campus-wide shoe design contest.

Featuring live performances by ROB ROY (with band) and COMPUTER JAY plus an EXTRA special guest.

Also featuring a live art installation by TY G HVW8 and SKYPAGER

Gallery installation with world renowned artists from HVW8 Gallery.  Limited prints will be available for sale.  


More information about the contest:

Enter to win!  Between January 7th-28th.
How it works:
1) Pick up a design template at the launch event on January 6th or in the Art Gallery all month long.
2) Get creative and draw out your best design.
3) Submit your finished design to the CAC office by January 28th (311 Kerkhoff Hall)
4) Design will be entered into the contest and considered to design UCLA's next pair of Study shoes!
5) Winner's design will be included in the Holiday 2011 Study Collection!  And the designer will have an opportunity for a 3 month design internship at the Study Footwear design offices!

More information about Study Footwear:

www.studyfootwear.com
Study Footwear is proud to be a product with a purpose.  For every pair of Study shoe sold a portion of proceeds are donated to the 'Study for Shoes Program".  Inspiring the youth of today.
Study, the brainchild of Stampd’LA (www.stampdla.com) designer Chris Stamp, kicks off an incentive-based school program that is set to motivate students to better themselves academically.
Portions from each sale of the Study collection will fund producing Study branded supplies such as stationary, pencils, and erasers giving students basic tools to start building their dreams. The Study school supplies will be donated to the creative arts departments of deserving schools in need. 
Inspired by his appreciation for how formal education has been an asset to his success as an artist, designer, and entrepreneur, Stamp strives to instill the same values in students today.  He wants to encourage young people to create—whether it be music, illustration, or even fashion design. The objective is that by providing these materials and incentives he is laying the foundation for a new generation of young artists.   

More information about the performing artists:

ROB ROY:
www.iamrobroy.com
www.myspace.com/robroy
www.dimmakrecs.com/emails/rob-roy/

COMPUTER JAY:
www.myspace.com/computerj
www.soundcloud.com/computerjay

HVW8 GALLERY and HVW8 artists TY G and SKYPAGER:
www.hvw8.com

More information about CAC's Art Series:
The Art Series strives to encouarge creativity and inspiration among UCLA students through interactive art installments, exhibitions, and collectives.  The Art Series hopes to successfully utilize art to highlight social issues and cultural trends.
www.culturalaffairsla.com
